question: True or false: fingerprint experts have declared a certain match between a crime-scene print and an innocent person?
answer: True. After the 2004 Madrid train bombings, an FBI database search put an Oregon lawyer, Brandon Mayfield, among its closest candidates; three FBI examiners and a court-appointed expert called the match certain. Spanish police traced the print to an Algerian man. Searching tens of millions of prints makes a convincing look-alike far more likely.
move: Search a big enough haystack and something will look like a needle.
trap: Fingerprints are unique, so a careful expert cannot confuse two.
reference: US Department of Justice, Office of the Inspector General, A Review of the FBI's Handling of the Brandon Mayfield Case, 2006
